title: SM-09.11 - How the inactive survey deletion process works
intent: This article answers: SM-09.11 - How the inactive survey deletion process works
short_answer: When a survey has not received new contributions for one year, EUSurvey starts a notification process before deletion. If the survey remains inactive after the notifications, it is automatically deleted from the system.
important_conditions: First notification: the survey owner and privileged management users are informed that the survey is inactive and subject to deletion.
Second notification: a reminder is sent if no action is taken.
Final notification: a last notification is sent before deletion.
The timing may change through configuration, but the initial schedule is 60 days, 45 days and 3 days before deletion.
